description: SEC Form N-PORT filings (NPORT-P, NPORT-P/A amendments) filed from 2024-06-01: one row per monthly portfolio report of a fund trust. period_ending = the month covered (filed up to 60 days later). Per-security holdings: get_fund_holdings, same filing_id. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on file_date. Defaults: sort file_date desc, limit 50. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_nport_filings

filer_name.description: Trust name part, any case; 1-3 chars = whole word.

is_amendment.description: true: NPORT-P/A only; false: NPORT-P only.
